title: Scorecard N/A Override Config
description: Per-repo override file declaring which F×T scorecard cells are degenerate for THIS repo's substrate (Phase 34, D-91). Lives at `.devai/config/scorecard-na.json` (optional; absence is a no-op). Extends Article 5 (degenerate cells) from a global structural claim to a per-repo substrate-shape claim. Each listed cell is forced to verdict 'N/A' as an overlay AFTER global DEGENERATE_CELLS and BEFORE reading-driven verdicts — so a stray SR cannot silently flip an N/A carve-out. Each cell MUST carry a `reason` so the carve-out is justified in writing.

cell.description: Cell coordinate in `Fx:Ty` form. F1-F5 substrate, T1-T9 property. Validation rejects coordinates outside the 5×9 grid.

reason.description: Human-readable justification for declaring this cell N/A on this repo. REQUIRED so the carve-out is auditable; silent N/A is the failure mode this schema exists to prevent.

constitution_anchor.description: Optional but recommended: cite the constitutional article that anchors the carve-out (typically Article 5 for substrate-shape mismatches).
